# Dashboard

`GRADED` `READ-ONLY` `DETERMINISTIC-MATH` `TIE-CHECKED` `PROVENANCE-STAMPED` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `AUDIT-TRAIL`

One self-contained HTML file — P&L trends, cash, A/R, KPIs — where every figure traces to a source and no figure is computed by the model. Tufte-style restraint, inline SVG charts, provenance footer per panel.

## Why these badges

- **`PROVENANCE-STAMPED`** — Every panel notes source and as-of date; unclosed-period numbers are marked preliminary; build date stamped prominently.
- **`TIE-CHECKED`** — Headline figures must tie to statement totals before the file is written. Red figures get a visible flag or the panel is dropped.
- **`DETERMINISTIC-MATH`** — The model writes the layout, never the numbers.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ledger.pnl-by-month` | **yes** | integration manifest | P&amp;L by month export |
| `ledger.balance-sheet` | no | integration manifest | omit balance panels |
| `ar.aging` | no | integration manifest | omit the receivables panel |
| `accounts.balances-as-of` | no | integration manifest | cash from the balance sheet date |
| `REPORT-PREFS.md` | **yes** | client workspace — which dashboard, KPI list, comparison basis, rounding | ask once |
| `CONTEXT.md` | **yes** | client workspace — KPI definitions | ask and capture there; never invent a metric definition |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| &lt;name&gt;.html | self-contained HTML | dashboards/ in the client workspace — inline CSS, inline SVG, no external deps, prints well |
| change note | chat | on refresh, a computed diff of headline figures since the last build |

## What it will not do

- Invent a KPI definition.
- Ship a figure that failed its tie-check.
